title: EXP-080 - Hello World Part 5 Section 3: Add the Derived Property FX_DerOrderTotal to the FX_Orders IDO
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 3 (03:33-05:05), adapted to FX_ names. In the Web Client IDO Collections runtime Form (titled IDOs), retrieve exactly the IDO FX_Orders (checked out to the operator; tables fxcus, fxitms and fxords; 16 properties after EXP-079) and record its identity, checkout state, Tables view and complete property inventory. Run the New Property wizard once, choose Derived instead of Bound on the first page, name the property FX_DerOrderTotal (the tutorial's Der-prefixed order total), select the existing property class FX_Cost, and enter the derived expression FX_Count * FX_ItmsCost (the tutorial's "count * itms cost", using the saved FX_Orders property names). Finish once. Close and reopen IDO Collections once and verify the inventory equals the baseline plus FX_DerOrderTotal, Derived, with its class and expression. The tutorial's Label String ID override and Read Only setting are EXP-081; its unload is deferred. FX_Orders stays checked out. Findings are observed only.
